checks: A halfspace retaining a mark restricts to a proper closed halfspace containing that mark in its intrinsic fiber plane, or to the whole plane. The retained fiber contributes at least its weight in either case, and all fibers are disjoint.

For n=0 distinct bases imply one fiber. Every intrinsic halfspace extends to the ambient space and every containing ambient trace is either such a halfspace or the whole plane. The strict face condition reduces to c_j > α.

For n≥1 and common direction V, write x=x_perp+x_parallel in orthonormal coordinates. The perpendicular coordinate is constant on each fiber and augments its base z. The original distinct z coordinates ensure distinct augmented bases, and this ambient isometry preserves halfspace traces and the intrinsic r-volume on each fiber. Full dimensionality in V and r≥1 give a minimizing cap through y with unit V-normal by 1ec728c26c11b368.

Writing the cap relative to every x_i gives the same ambient affine margin -t_i evaluated at every graph atom. Under equality of total mass with α, retained weights sum to α and all retained traces cost exactly their weights. A retained negative threshold strictly increases the volume of the through-mark cap by a positive slab in the relative ball around x_i, so every retained t_i is zero. Excluded thresholds are strictly positive by the definition of retention.

Every atom on the minimal face receives positive weight in some single convex representation of y, constructed by averaging the opposite-direction representations. The ambient affine margins sum to zero at y. Nonnegative cutoffs therefore vanish for all those atoms, forcing their total weight to be at most α in the equality case.
